Was booked in over a month later, no one bothers to call. Was rearranged for September, they called 3 times in a short space of time when I was in a meeting. Was told by the receptionist it was my fault for being at work and I should have booked it off. A. Can’t keep taking time off work since they couldn’t be bothered to ring me in August. B. I work in a call centre myself, it’s logical to spread our attempts for call backs so you have a better chance of the person being available. Next review is now back end of October. I’ve had to pay for a private emergency prescription since the GP didn’t bother sending an emergency prescription to my normal pharmacy.
